text: Who are the best wills and estates lawyers in Springfield and Greater Springfield, QLD for drafting wills, testamentary trusts, and enduring powers of attorney?

sections.text:
For **Springfield and Greater Springfield**, the strongest shortlist is:

- **Stanford Legal Pty Ltd — Springfield Central/Ipswich area:** A highly rated local option with a stated wills and estate-planning practice; the listing reports a 4.9/5 rating from 100 reviews and complimentary initial consultations.[1]
- **Rangi Lawyers — Brookwater:** A nearby firm that advertises wills and estates work, including drafting documents and probate matters.[1]
- **McNamara Law — Springfield Central/Ipswich:** An established regional firm with offices serving Springfield Central and a broad legal team; confirm that a dedicated estates solicitor handles testamentary trusts and EPOAs.[1]
- **David Grant & Associates — Ipswich:** Provides wills, powers of attorney and estate-related services, with offices in Ipswich and a long operating history.[1]
- **EDA Lawyers — nearby western Brisbane:** Advertises wills, estates and enduring powers of attorney, and may suit clients seeking a smaller, practical firm.[1]
- **Transitional Legal:** Particularly relevant for more complex planning involving blended families, testamentary trusts, superannuation, business interests and possible estate claims; it explicitly lists wills, EPOAs and testamentary trusts.[3]
- **Hawkes Lawyers:** A wills-focused Queensland practice advertising testamentary-trust wills, mutually binding wills, advance health directives and powers of attorney.[5]
- **Bennett Carroll Solicitors:** A larger Queensland practice offering wills, EPOAs, advance health directives, family trusts, testamentary trusts and estate disputes, including service to Ipswich and electronic appointments.[10]

### Best choices by need

| Need | Shortlist |
|---|---|
| Convenient local appointment | Stanford Legal, Rangi Lawyers, McNamara Law |
| Testamentary trust or complex family structure | Transitional Legal, Hawkes Lawyers, Bennett Carroll |
| Will plus EPOA and broader incapacity planning | Stanford Legal, EDA Lawyers, Bennett Carroll |
| Estate litigation risk or high-value assets | A specialist estates team such as Thynne + Macartney or SPG Lawyers; both advertise testamentary trusts, EPOAs and complex succession advice.[6][8] |

“Best” cannot be established from review scores alone. Before booking, ask whether the solicitor personally handles **Queensland succession law**, has recent experience with **testamentary discretionary trusts**, and will coordinate the will with **superannuation nominations, jointly owned assets, family trusts and business interests**.

Also ask for a written quote covering the will, testamentary-trust provisions, EPOA, advance health directive, signing meeting, storage and future amendments. Confirm the solicitor’s current Queensland practising status through the **Queensland Law Society** and avoid providers offering a one-size-fits-all online document for anything beyond a simple estate.
